note: Context Builder stage 1 (P1-H, diagnostics only): only with ?debugLog=1 the chat screen builds a read-only report of every route's final candidates (contextBuilder.ts: kinds, people, relevance to the question's purpose, 採用/保留/除外 and a virtual input to compare with) from the very values of the request body, next to the existing P1-F provenance; it is kept in the tab's memory only (contextBuilderStore.ts) and shown in the debug badge. The request body, the prompt, its order and its counts are the same with or without it; a failure is caught and the message is sent as before.
